generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL GAME DIFFUSE/ALBEDO TEXTURE ATLAS, not a rendered object. Create one square flat texture atlas for a small 75 by 120 mm stiff field-clinician triage card in a restrained weathered semi-photoreal survival game. The image is a perfectly flat uniformly lit scanned paper surface, no perspective and no cast shadows. The whole square is dusty pink-tan warm fibrous cardstock, base roughly #c8b1a0, with subtle realistic tiny paper fibers, sparse tiny specks, light localized handling smudges and quiet fine surface variation; not parchment, concrete, fabric or leather. ATLAS LAYOUT: left half is card front and right half is card back, each full-height portrait panel with a narrow tan separator at center. Do not draw the outside silhouette, physical card edges, holes, grommets or 3D bevels: these will be modeled separately. On the left/front panel only, add a restrained faded brick-red (#9d2f2a) narrow horizontal form header rule at 18 percent from the top, a thin faded red side accent near its far left margin, and three widely spaced extremely fine incomplete brown-neutral form rules across its middle/lower area. Leave most of the front calm for dynamic readable text applied separately. Right/back panel almost blank with very faint ink show-through and natural fibers; no form lines on back. No outlines or decorative border. CRITICAL: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, stamps, crosses, logos, icons, symbols, badges, labels, watermarks, strings or metal components. No heavy stains or blood. Neutral albedo only, no dramatic lighting, highlights, shading gradients or baked ambient occlusion. Square edge-to-edge texture, opaque.
